_transcript: [m0][00:00][client] There are several results for the company I'm looking up. How can I find the exact stock?

[m1][00:01][bot] Hello! I'm AIM, the Freedom Broker AI assistant. I can answer questions about products and services, provide information about your accounts, assets and fees, compare information in a table, share your account manager's contact details, and pass your question to our support team.
[m2][00:01][bot] By continuing this conversation, you agree to the collection and processing of your personal data and confirm that you have read the company's Privacy Policy.
[m3][00:13][bot] Try searching by ticker in Quotes.
[m4][00:32][client] I have the ticker but I'm still new to this. Can I talk to an agent?
[m5][00:36][bot] Would you like me to connect you with an agent?
[m6][00:42][client] Yes, please
[m7][00:43][bot] Please wait. An agent will join the chat shortly.
[m8][00:46][system] Chat transferred to an agent.
[m9][01:08][client] I have the app open already.
[m10][01:47][operator] Hi, I'm Sofia. Enter the ticker in the search bar under Quotes. Check that the result shows the ticker you intended before opening an order.

[m12][02:55][operator] Open that security, fill in the buy order parameters and review them before submitting the order.
[m13][03:25][client] I'm just looking for now. Thank you.
[m14][03:39][client] Hang on, I have another question. The order screen has a Use Margin checkbox. How do I turn that off?
[m15][04:26][operator] Before you submit, open Order Settings and untick Use Margin.
[m16][04:44][client] Found it. Does that change a position I already own?
[m17][05:22][operator] That setting is for the order you're entering now. It doesn't answer what's happening with an existing position.
[m18][05:44][client] Okay, I'll leave the order unsubmitted for now.
[m19][06:13][operator] Of course. Have a good day!
